critique: Three passes of three: RAID AGAIN is the widest, most saturated control at the foot and leads in grayscale; Home, the 3 s replay, the Starlight card and the law pills do not compete.

Three fails of three: HEIST COMPLETE, 'Clean', the subtitle lines and the Entry fee / Re-simulated lines sit straight on the sky art with no ink outline ('Clean' has only a soft drop, which does not count), and the reward totals +2,310 / +805 / +15 are flat fills with no outline, hard drop or gradient (+2,310 is also dark on cream while the others are cream on dark). Narrow point: outline every word over art and give the headline numbers the display treatment.

Three fails of three: the crew strip shows three overlapping portraits of about 45 px at 960 in a secondary strip near the foot, the pale one blending into its lavender ring, and the reward cards hold no character art; the pass anchor shows five separate portraits of about 60 px. Narrow point: give the crew separate, larger portraits (or put a character on the reward) so the screen has a character presence at the anchor's scale.

Three fails of three: 'ASSALTO CONCLUÍDO' sits on the starburst with no ink outline, 'Limpo' has only a drop shadow, and the '3 s' replay chip is clipped and loses glyphs. Narrow point: outline the header and rank word, and let the 3 s chip grow with the text.
Three passes of three: ASSALTAR DE NOVO is the largest, most saturated control at the foot; Início is about half its height and the 3 s chip a minor second.

Three passes of three: gold fills only actions (RAID AGAIN and the 3 s replay), gold elsewhere is rim; green means success only; the currencies differ by shape on all three colour-blindness sheets. Closest point: the gold 3 s replay is a second gold-filled action.
Three passes of three: RAID AGAIN spans most of the width at the foot and leads by size and place; the light cards are light by the mode's design.
